description: This source file contains functions related to parsing object IDs (OIDs) in a Git-like version control system. It includes setup for hash algorithms, parsing hexadecimal OID strings, and utility functions for handling object IDs using specific hash algorithms.

methods.name: int cl_setup_hash_algo(void)
methods.description: Determines and caches the hash algorithm to be used, defaulting to SHA1 or as specified by the environment variable.

methods.name: void cl_parse_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an object ID using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: void cl_parse_any_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Uses the current hash algorithm to parse a hexadecimal OID string into an object ID.

ctags.name: cl_parse_oid
ctags.signature: (const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
